response.sql: WITH budget_expenses AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_expense, COUNT(*) as num_expenses FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_budget_expense AS (SELECT AVG(total_expense) as avg_spend FROM budget_expenses), above_average AS (SELECT be.link_to_budget, be.total_expense, be.num_expenses, abe.avg_spend FROM budget_expenses be CROSS JOIN avg_budget_expense abe WHERE be.total_expense > abe.avg_spend) SELECT AVG(total_expense) as average_total, SUM(num_expenses) as total_expenses, AVG(total_expense - avg_spend) as average_excess FROM above_average
